news.headline: Things you don't know about Patriots running back Rhamondre Stevenson
news.detail: Stevenson does all the little things for the Patriots, and he's on the cusp of 100 carries for the sixth straight season.

news.headline: Stevenson saw twice the rushing workload of backfield mate TreVeyon Henderson but gained only five more yards. Stevenson
news.detail: Stevenson saw twice the rushing workload of backfield mate TreVeyon Henderson but gained only five more yards. Stevenson also recorded 12 of his yards on one carry, so he ran for next to nothing on his other 13 rush attempts in what was his second-least productive game on the ground this season. Hen
